items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: And so I recorded with Laverné Baker, I think that was the first rock and roll date that I did, was with her.

ctx.x: And so I recorded with Laverné Baker, I think that was the first rock and roll date that I did, was with her. But Joe Marshall was partly responsible for me doing that.

Let's see if you and I can historically bring this thing, which is most important -- and your memory is much better than mine. But when we worked together, you came into Cab Callaway's band in 1946, and I had come in at 1936, so I had been in the band 10 years when you came in.
